{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 6:30). The picture confirms the nose is now fixed: the dark chain runs from START up through the nose, over the top line, and joins the belly near (23,10), so the whole figure is connected. Only three pale strays remain near the nose, about (6.3-7, 8.5-9.5). That matches Hana's report of 108 of 111 and her claim that the strays don't matter. I still can't attribute hands-on credit. No hand labels, and I don't know who placed which domino.

Hana: Said at 6:00 that the nose looks good, gave an accurate count, and chose to leave it alone to avoid breaking anything. She asked others to keep off the nose. She closed the joint she has owned since about 2:00, and her reporting has been honest and checkable. Strong on ownership and judgment. Open question: did she fix it herself or did Jack's help close it? Ask in the review. Early diagnosis still counts for her.

Sofia: At 6:15 she backed Hana's plan, announced a look-only check of the middle crossing, and told everyone to keep hands off the nose and middle. Good coordination, and she is protecting the work. Still no observed hands-on building or problem-spotting. The middle appears clean in the picture, but I didn't hear her confirm it. Collaboration and leadership are solid. Execution is unproven.

Jack: Not heard this visit. Hana asked him to give the tail a final look. Earlier he reported accurately and went to help with the nose. Ask what he found at the tail and whether he helped close the nose.

Omar: Not heard again. His top line is built and now connected, but I can't confirm it's his work. Ask how he aligned it to the nose. Reliable but quiet, so I have little evidence on collaboration and leadership."}
